The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8080` (see `KustoBuilder.KustoPort`)
- Environment variable: `ACCEPT_EULA=Y`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `POST /v1/rest/mgmt` to port `8080` is completed successfully.
